name: kubexporter-headlamp-plugin
description: Headlamp plugin for visualizing KubExporter OpenReports export statistics

scripts.package: rm -f *.tar.gz && headlamp-plugin package && tar xzf *.tar.gz && mv headlamp kubexporter && tar czf kubexporter-headlamp-plugin-$(node -p "require('./package.json').version").tar.gz kubexporter && rm -rf kubexporter && rm -f *.sha256
